name: decentralized-trace
cmd: GDP_JOIN_TRACE=1 GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 90 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only decentralized_lock --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log; s=$?; grep -E 'join (grow|end|engine|set|enumerated)|infer join\] .*(ms":[0-9]{4}|inductive)|houdini\]' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-220 | tail -c 30000; exit $s

name: wo-p12-replay
cmd: bun add z3-solver@5.3.3 >/dev/null 2>&1; gunzip -c research/protocols/engine/dumps/wo-td-base.jsonl.gz > /tmp/wo.jsonl; WO_Z3=1 timeout -s KILL 700 bun research/protocols/engine/wodl.ts replay /tmp/wo.jsonl 1000 2>&1 | cut -c1-300 | tail -c 40000; WO_Z3=1 timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/protocols/engine/wodl.ts given 1000 2>&1 | tail -3 | cut -c1-200
